description: Multi-step Snowpark pipeline — all compute pushed to Snowflake (one query plan per asset).

inputs.description: Upstream table(s) referenced by name via source {kind: table|sql|ref} — no data passed; there is no wired-upstream source kind for this component.

outputs.description: Only when sink kind=none (returned as pandas through the IO manager); the default (sink kind=table) instead materializes directly to Snowflake and downstream components should reference the table by name, not via this port.

connection.label: Connection
connection.description: Snowpark connection params (account/user/password/role/warehouse/database/schema). Any field may end with '_env_var' to read from an env var.

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Flat shape: Snowpark DataFrame ops. Supported: filter, select, drop, rename, with_columns, group_by, sort, limit, distinct, drop_nulls, join, union, sql, ml (in-warehouse ML via snowflake-ml-python — kmeans/dbscan/logistic_regression/xgb_classifier/random_forest_regressor/etc.). The `ml` op supports Snowflake Model Registry via `model_name` / `model_version` / `registry_database` / `registry_schema` / `model_comment` / `predict_function` fields — set `model_name` on a fit-mode op to persist the fitted model, then set `mode: predict` (or `transform`) + `model_name` in a separate pipeline to load and score.

sink.label: Sink
sink.description: Top-level single-sink shape: {kind: table|none, table, mode: overwrite|append}

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Multi-step form. Each step: {id, source: {kind: table|sql|ref, ...}, operations: [...]}. 'op: sql' uses create_or_replace_temp_view('self' + step ids) + session.sql(...).

sinks.label: Sinks
sinks.description: Multi-step form. Each sink: {from: <step_id>, kind: table|none, table, mode}.

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
